---
title: "Ethical Issues"
---



Ethical issues: The use of AI to write resumes raises concerns about fairness in hiring. Applicants who use AI tools may have an advantage over those who do not. For example, some applicants use AI as a shortcut to adjust their base resume to the job they are applying to. Another way that some use AI to their advantage is by adding keywords that they know the AI will identify as qualified. Employers may also struggle to determine whether resumes accurately represent a candidate’s real skills and experiences. In addition to fairness, this ethical issue also raises concerns about trust, bias, and transparency. Transparency is important because employers may not know how much of a resume was generated by AI.
Bias can occur if AI tools favor certain writing styles or backgrounds.
Accessibility is a concern because not all applicants have equal access to AI tools.
Trust is affected when employers are unsure whether resumes reflect genuine skills.
